about: Multi-turn and re-check evals (P0, 22 Nov). Each case is a conversation; every turn has its expected route (fact / recheck / open) and the company it must be about. Re-check turns must start a live, read-only ERP fetch for that company and answer with the fetch's time; they never repeat the old verdict as if fresh. No case may expect 'you're not on it'. Run in the page with the model on (ask-ping reachable) and off (ask-ping blocked): setup/multiturn_page_evals.js; the routing alone: tests/js/recheck.test.js.
